headline: Stilly Puts Out a Fire, Then the Fire Truck Breaks Down
publicationDraft: With Chris Carson sidelined by a neck injury, Stilly dealt from a receiving corps featuring Diggs, Moore, Lamb and Diontae Johnson to acquire Kareem Hunt. Tony had just benched Hunt's 23.40-point outing. Four days later, Hunt injured his calf while starting for Cleveland; Lamb delivered 31.60 for Tony that same week. Hunt returned in November, then injured his ankle in December. His two observed starts supplied just 12.10 points, while Lamb contributed 109.70 in paired matchups, including 8.40 in Tony's narrow championship win. The roster logic was sound, but the return was a disaster. Stilly bought a fire extinguisher that caught fire.
